These domains can transport ligands to facilitate lipid… 47240151 comparative-structural-analysis-of-lipid-binding-start-domains comparative structural analysis lipid binding start domains background BACKGROUND Steroidogenic acute regulatory (StAR) protein related lipid transfer (START) domains are small globular modules that form a ca Comparative Structural Analysis of Lipid Binding START Domains BACKGROUND Steroidogenic acute regulatory (StAR) protein related lipid transfer (START) domains are small globular modules that form a cavity where lipids and lipid hormones bind. These domains can transport ligands to facilitate lipid exchange between biological membranes, and they have been postulated to modulate the activity of other domains of the protein in response to ligand binding. More than a dozen human genes encode START domains, and several of them are implicated in a disease. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS We report crystal structures of the human STARD1, STARD5, STARD13 and STARD14 lipid transfer domains. These represent four of the six functional classes of START domains.
